summary: On an Operator install with OCI delivery, upgrade by updating the version tag at the end of each `package` URL in the `rhaap-dynamic-plugins-config` ConfigMap and saving; RHDH reloads the plug-ins automatically.
questions: How do I upgrade the Ansible plug-ins with the RHDH Operator?
Do I need to restart RHDH after changing the plug-ins ConfigMap?
